title: Resilient by Design Webinar
subject: Resilient by Design Webinar
body:
Backups are only part of the resilience story. Customers also need confidence that they can recover clean data and restore critical services when an attack happens.

The Resilient by Design webinar walks through a simulated recovery scenario, from detection to validated restoration, and gives you a practical way to bring clean recovery into your customer conversations.

Use it to help customers think beyond backup and focus on recovery they can trust.

The Cyber Risk Mitigation & Recovery campaign is ready in the Partner Marketing Hub with co-brandable emails, social content and customer-facing assets to help you take that message to market.

Activate Campaign Now

Watch the webinar, activate the campaign and bring a stronger recovery story to your customers.

Thank you for being a valued partner!
Partner Marketing Team
